htn_kidney.title: Associations Between Elevated Anticardiolipin IgG, Thrombocytopenia, and Combined Diabetes-Hypertension Etiology in Hemodialysis Patients.
htn_kidney.authors: Makhdoom HQ, Sandokji I, Almutairi YH
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：糖尿病高血压肾病独特的病理生理学可能与可能导致抗磷脂抗体产生和血栓并发症的微环境有关。 临床提示：本研究旨在调查血液透析 (HD) 患者中 aCL IgG 升高是否与糖尿病高血压 (DM + HTN) 病因和血小板减少症相关，从而确定临床上不同的
htn_kidney.abstract: Background: Elevated anticardiolipin IgG (aCL IgG) has been reported in end-stage renal disease (ESRD), but its association with specific etiologies of kidney failure remains unexplored. The unique pathophysiology of diabetic-hypertensive nephropathy may be associated with a microenvironment that could potentially contribute to antiphospholipid antibody production and thrombotic complications. This study aimed to investigate whether aCL IgG elevation in hemodialysis (HD) patients is associated with combined diabetes-hypertension (DM + HTN) etiology and thrombocytopenia, thereby identifying a clinically distinct potential high-risk subgroup. portal_hypertension.title: Reliability of Hepatic Steatosis Quantification by Controlled Attenuation Parameter in Steatotic Liver Disease.
portal_hypertension.journal: Clinical gastroenterology and hepatology : the official clinical practice journal of the American Gastroenterological Association
portal_hypertension.authors: Simonis L, Marcour Y, Embacher J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 40）。核心观点：在 4 个队列中评估了 28 天内不同日的可重复性：疑似 SLD（III，n=37）、疑似纤维化（IV，n=163）、代偿性晚期 SLD（V，n=32）和临床显着的门静脉高压... 临床提示：肝脏脂肪变性的评估是诊断和监测脂肪性肝病 (SLD) 的关键。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Assessment of hepatic steatosis is key for diagnosis and monitoring of steatotic liver disease (SLD). Controlled attenuation parameter (CAP) is widely used, but concerns regarding its measurement variability exist. We evaluated the repeatability and reproducibility of CAP and FibroScan-AST (FAST) score across different clinical SLD settings and disease stages. We assessed same-day repeatability in subjects with suspected SLD in secondary care (Cohort I, n=40) and tertiary care (II, n=58). portal_hypertension.title: Changes in Disease Severity and Outcomes Among Electively Admitted Cirrhosis Patients During the COVID-19 Era.
portal_hypertension.authors: Ardelean MV, Buzas DR, Istodor AV
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：背景：由 SARS-CoV-2 病毒引起的 2019 冠状病毒病（COVID-19）对全球健康产生了深远的主要影响，并通过广泛破坏医疗保健系统而产生二次影响，限制了人们获得必要的选择性医疗服务的机会。 临床提示：背景：2019 年冠状病毒病 (COVID-19) 由 SARS-CoV-2 病毒引起，对全球健康产生深远的主要影响，并通过广泛破坏医疗保健系统、限制获得医疗服务而产生二次影响。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Background : Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, had profound primary effects on global health and secondary effects through widespread disruption of healthcare systems, limiting access to elective medical services essential for the management of chronic diseases such as liver cirrhosis. Elective hospitalizations play a key role in disease monitoring, prevention of complications, and therapeutic optimization. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of the pandemic on the clinical profile, disease severity, and outcomes of patients electively admitted with liver cirrhosis across three periods: pre-pandemic, pandemic, and post-pandemic.
